opportunities.name: Plan city trip and log summary note
opportunities.description: For a destination city and date range, search round-trip flights from Paris on Google Flights, search hotels on Booking.com, find a tour on Viator, then append a one-line trip summary (flight price, hotel, tour price) to the Notes app.
steps: Open Google Flights with origin Paris; set 'Where to?' to {destination} and pick the city option
Open the date picker, select {depart_date} and {return_date}, click Done and run the search
Record the best/cheapest flight's airline and price
On Booking.com, enter {destination}, pick the city suggestion, select check-in {depart_date} and check-out {return_date}, click Search
Open the top hotel and record its name and total price
On Viator, search '{tour_query}', skip dates and open the top result; record its title and price
In Notes, type 'Trip {destination} {depart}-{return}: flight {airline} {price}, hotel {hotel} {price}, {tour_query}: {tour_title} {tour_price}' into New note and press Enter

instances.values: Rome, Dec 3–Dec 7 2026, tour 'Colosseum tour Rome'; note: easyJet 89, Room Roma Nazionale 452, Colosseum tour 54.00
Barcelona, Jan 20–Jan 24 2027, tour 'Sagrada Familia tour Barcelona'; note: Vueling-Iberia EUR113, IBIS BUDGET BARCELONA CENTER EUR543, Sagrada Familia tour EUR54.00

opportunities.name: Browser-support lookup and email reply
opportunities.description: Look up a web feature on caniuse.com and MDN, then draft a reply email to a colleague stating the first supporting version in a given browser with the MDN docs link.
steps: On caniuse.com, clear the search box, type {feature} and press Enter
Read the first supported version for {browser} from the support table
On MDN, click 'Search the site', type {feature}, press Enter and open the matching reference page; copy its URL
In the mail app, fill To = {recipient_email}
Fill Subject = 'Re: {feature} in {browser}'
Fill Body = 'Hi {name}, {feature} is supported in {browser} from version {version}. Docs: {mdn_url}'
Send (the recording discarded the draft)

instances.values: CSS container queries (only the caniuse lookup was done; no MDN or email step in the recording)

opportunities.name: Compare two PyPI packages and log note
opportunities.description: For two Python packages, open each on PyPI, read version/release date, visit the repository for stars and license, and append a comparison line to Notes.
steps: In the PyPI search box, type {package_a} and press Enter
Open the exact-match result; record version and release date
Click the Source/Repository link; record star count and license
Repeat the search, open and repository steps for {package_b}
In Notes, type '{a} {ver} {date} {stars} stars {license} vs {b} {ver} {date} {stars} stars {license}' and press Enter

instances.values: requests vs httpx (partial: searched both and opened only the httpx source; no note)

opportunities.name: Google Flights round-trip search
opportunities.description: Search round-trip flights from Paris to a given destination for given dates on Google Flights.
steps: Click 'Where to?', select all and type {destination}
Pick the matching city option
Click Departure, go to the next month if needed, pick {depart_date} then {return_date}
Click Done, then Search (click Reload if an error page appears)
Review the top flights

opportunities.name: Booking.com hotel search
opportunities.description: Search Booking.com hotels for a destination and check-in/check-out dates, then open the top result.
steps: Click 'Enter destination', select all and type {destination}
Pick the city suggestion
Open the date picker, go to the right month, click {checkin} then {checkout}
Click Search
Open the top hotel listing and note its price

instances.values: Barcelona, Jan 20–Jan 24 2027 → IBIS BUDGET BARCELONA CENTER

opportunities.name: Viator tour search
opportunities.description: Search Viator for a tour query and open the top result to read its title and price.
steps: Click the search box, select all and type {tour_query}
Press Enter (skip the date picker if it appears)
Open the first result and record its title and price

opportunities.description: Search PyPI for a package, open its page and follow its source/repository link.
steps: Click the search box, type {package} and press Enter
Click the exact-match result
Click the Source/Repository link
